items.title: Establishment variance: shell/site swing G1<->G2 across same-arm runs; ground/food are hard gaps
items.target_gap: establishment.score swings 2.0-3.0 across same-arm runs; G2 needs 2.5 (standard)
evidence: Cross-run (same arm, re-scored with fixed metric): -5 score=3.0 site=yes shell=yes (G2); -6 score=2.5 site=yes shell=yes (G2); -7 score=2.0 site=partial shell=NO (G1). Different emergent missions (t_f8d7b177/t_016c86a0/t_5d0bbe09).
SWING milestone = shell (walls+roof) + site completion: succeeds in -5/-6, fails in -7 -> NAV/place-on-village variance, NOT a hard ceiling. Matches [[project_genesis_v2_validated]] ceiling.
HARD gaps (never reached in any of -5/-6/-7): ground=level pad, food=farm. These are genuine missing capabilities, not variance.
Caveat: emergent missions differ per run, so establishment is NOT apples-to-apples across -5/-6/-7; compare_safe only gates operational safety, not mission equivalence.

FIELD OBS gv2-2026-06-22-1 (operator watched build): chests placed FIRST, then slab built at SAME y surrounding them, then stone layer on top -> wrong y-references + wrong order. Root cause of shell/site failure is y-discipline + build sequencing, not motor capability. See [[feedback_base_build_standards]].
items.candidate_direction: Sub-target A (operator-directed via field obs) is now concrete = BASE-BUILD STANDARD: (1) assess base area; (2) distinguish stand_y vs place-at y in card/skill language; (3) order = solid level slab FIRST -> chests/doors at next level (on slab) -> ceiling +2-3 above; never chests before slab. Encode in genesis-v2-blueprint-plan + minecraft-building skills + planner SOUL. Sub-target B (ground/food templates) still open. Pairs with gv2-reserved-structure-override (relocation needs an override path).
items.blocked_by: gv2-scope-coverage-metric + gv2-board-quality-supply-cards validation on gv2-2026-06-22-1 (don't stack behavioral changes before current fixes validate). ALSO the per-profile bot-lease finding (gv2-bot-lease-shared-db) confounds establishment until fixed.
items.notes: PROPOSED. Sub-target A now has a concrete operator spec (base-build standard, [[feedback_base_build_standards]]). Behavioral change; validate on same arm (>=2 runs). Do not implement inside the autonomous loop without escalation.

items.title: Agents need a sanctioned override to break/relocate reserved structures (chests/doors)
items.target_gap: Reserved cells block placement with no override path -> agents trapped (mis-placed chest, door/goto traps) and cannot fix the base.
evidence: Operator (gv2-2026-06-22-1): agents should be able to break/relocate chests, doors, and other reserved structures when the plan needs it. Today CONSTRUCT protected_cells:/clear-authorization only BLOCKS; there is no grant path.
Relates to [[feedback_base_build_standards]] and the door/goto-trap ceiling in [[project_genesis_v2_validated]].
items.candidate_direction: Two mechanisms (either/both): (1) overseer access request -> grant (worker emits a request card/event, overseer authorizes a one-time break/relocate on named reserved cells); (2) card-level pre-authorization extending CONSTRUCT clear-authorization to named reserved structures. Keep the default protective; the override is explicit + auditable.
items.blocked_by: Validation of current fixes; design choice on mechanism (1) vs (2) vs both. Overseer is a bodiless role today.
items.notes: PROPOSED + needs operator design choice on the grant mechanism. Behavioral; touches overseer role + validator protected-cells semantics. Do not implement in the autonomous loop without escalation.
